'''''Kinslayer''''' can refer to the following:

* [[Lews Therin Telamon|Kinslayer]] - a nickname for Lews Therin Telamon.
* [[Kinslayer's Dagger]] - a mountain range that extends westward from the [[Spine of the World]].
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 15|Kinslayer]]'' - the fifteenth chapter of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* [[KinslayerMUD]] - an online role-playing game.
